composition_subtypes.role: Process students in decreasing skill order
Efficient O(1) removal and neighbor access of chosen segment

payload.core_composition_summary: Sorts students by skill descending, then uses doubly linked list (as ordered set) for O(1) removal of k-nearest neighbors during team selection.
payload.rationale: Solution first sorts to pick max skill, then uses linked list to efficiently remove segments; both mechanisms are coordinated and essential.
